usageNotes: Use this endpoint to get a high-level health summary of the Ceph cluster — overall health status, IOPS, throughput, and pool/OSD counts — without targeting a specific node. Requires Sys.Audit or Datastore.Audit on the root path. The cluster must have Ceph configured; calling this on a cluster with no Ceph deployment will return an error.

examples.summary: Fetch Ceph cluster health and performance overview

tips: The returned object includes a 'health' sub-object with a 'status' field — values are HEALTH_OK, HEALTH_WARN, or HEALTH_ERR.
Check 'pgmap' fields (bytes_used, bytes_avail, num_pgs) for storage utilization and PG state counts.
This is a cluster-level call, not node-level — no node parameter is needed; any cluster member can serve it.
For per-OSD or per-pool detail, follow up with get_nodes_ceph_osd or get_nodes_ceph_pools on a specific node.
